prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity landscape 1920x1080 game trade screen concept, in the existing Stone & Shadow UI style.
Input images: image 1 is the actual innkeeper dialogue capture, a reference for the world, exact innkeeper identity, overall frame and exact party sidebar. Image 2 is the actual Inventory & Equipment screen, a reference ONLY for square item slots, painted item artwork, typography and dark panel treatment; do not copy its fullscreen layout.
Primary request: show the trade interface opened from the innkeeper's Trade discussion topic. TWO ITEM GRIDS, merchant on the LEFT and the selected player's bag on the RIGHT. Keep all four existing party cards fully visible and selectable in their original far-right sidebar. One coherent full game screen, no explanatory annotations, no comparison panels.

Composition: 1920x1080 landscape. Keep thin top title bar at y=6..45. Main world viewport retains original geometry x=12..1512, y=54..900. A dark trade overlay covers the lower part of that unchanged viewport and replaces the dialogue panels/action dock/log, x=12..1512, y=310..1074. Above the trade overlay, the innkeeper's grey-bearded face, shoulders, pottery shelves and timber/plaster inn remain visible, using the same current-world camera framing. Do NOT resize the world viewport, render a detached merchant portrait, use a separate illustrated backdrop, or add a new room. Character portraits stay in sidebar x=1524..1908, four stacked cards y=54..882.

Style: native fantasy dungeon crawler UI, deep charcoal-green solid rectangular panels, restrained thin antique-gold borders, gold serif headings, pale cream readable body text, muted grey secondary copy, square buttons. Faithful to screenshot reference, clean and practical; no decorative flourishes, wood-carved UI, modern rounded cards, blur or gradients.

Top bar text: "STONE & SHADOW" left; "TRADE" centered; "Sanctuary inn" near right.
Trade panel has a narrow heading line at y=326: "INNKEEPER" on left and "ALDEN'S BAG" on right. A small subtitle on right: "Buying & selling as Alden". Far right of panel, gold balance "Gold: 180". Two equal-width inventory areas separated by a slim vertical gold rule near x=762.

Grids: left grid starts around x=36,y=394, right grid x=804,y=394. Each grid EXACTLY 8 columns and 6 rows of square slots, total 48 slots per side, approximately 78px square with 6px gutters. Both grids about 672px wide and 504px tall. Plenty of empty dark green slots; do not fill the merchant inventory with invented merchandise. Thin subdued borders, painted icons like existing inventory screenshot. Quantity numbers in lower right of occupied slots. Merchant occupied slots additionally have a compact readable gold price along bottom, without obscuring quantities.
Merchant has exactly these three normal stock items in first three slots: a canvas-wrapped food/ration bundle quantity 4, price 120g; a round red healing potion quantity 3, price 50g; a round blue mana potion quantity 3, price 65g. Select the ration pack with bright gold slot border. The fourth merchant slot holds one brown leather armor, price 15g, with a small readable "BUYBACK" label at its top. This is a sold item, visibly differentiated from ordinary stock; do not add an extra buyback tab. Empty remaining slots.
Player bag contains a red healing potion stack quantity 2, a small dagger quantity 1, and a pouch of gold coins in first three slots; other slots empty. No player slot selected. No equipment silhouette or equipment actions on this screen.

Below grids, around y=910, merchant text "Restocks in 2 days"; smaller muted "Buyback expires in 18h". Player text "Weight: 65 / 240 lb"; smaller muted "Select a party portrait to change character."

A compact shared selected-item/action strip spans the bottom of the trade overlay y=950..1074, separated by a thin gold line. Left: small ration bundle icon and bold gold "RATION PACK", below "Supplies for one party long rest." and muted "120g each · 4 in stock". Middle: quantity controls with separate square minus button, "Quantity 1", separate square plus button. Next "Total: 120g". Right: clear gold-outlined button "BUY FOR ALDEN". An unobtrusive "Back to conversation" control along lower left of footer, with small "Esc: back" nearby. All UI text accurately spelled, high contrast and comfortably legible, no tiny invented fine print.

Sidebar: preserve the SAME four portrait identities, names, order, HP/mana and current original framing from image 1: Alden fighter, Brunna cleric, Merrin rogue, Lethiel wizard. Alden's card has a bright double gold outline and the small status "TRADING", visibly tying him to the right-hand bag and Buy button. Other cards are undimmed and appear clickable. Do not duplicate portraits in the trade panel. Preserve full portrait visibility, do not cover the sidebar with modal dimming.
Constraints: this is a static design reference illustrating buying a ration pack. Prices, stock and timers are sample values, but do not put implementation notes or a mockup watermark inside the game UI. Selecting a player item would show a Sell action instead; this image shows ONLY the buying state. No quests, barter basket, sell-all, haggling, equipment comparison popup, combat controls, cursor, tooltip or additional services. Preserve the traditional two-grid trade flow.
